[[Shiro's Sword]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] traded by [[Adept of Steel]], a [[collector]] who can be found in [[Divine Path]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 13 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 3
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:Health +30
